description: A component whose body holds an `<md>` with text slots, used inside an `<each>` row, renders each row's prop values: a row-bound prop reads the row and a literal prop is its literal.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY) · review:s465-md finding 1
rationale: §67.4: an atom renders exactly as `${expr}` renders in a markup body (§7.4.2); in a component body a prop name in that expression is the prop (§15.10), so in an `<each>` row it is the caller's per-row value — never an unbound name.
